text:
alex: Hi team — ACME POC update. They can authenticate via SAML, but SCIM isn't mapping groups to Dedicated pool roles. Need help. :confused:

maria_se: @alex what do you mean by "Dedicated pool roles"? They want group->role so devs get read/write and prod gets inference-only?

alex: Exactly. They sent SAML assertion with `groups` claim but it's a big list and Okta seems to truncate it. They also want SCIM to provision group membership into our `rdw_role` attribute.

jenny_acme: FWIW our Okta admin keeps seeing SCIM sync succeed but users show up without any roles in the console.

okta-bot: SCIM sync finished — 1 user updated, 0 groups provisioned. Logs: `Group provisioning disabled`.

prashant_eng: Two quick checks: 1) Is the SCIM integration configured to push groups? 2) Are we mapping `groups` to `rdw_role` in the SCIM attribute map? If not, we only get users.

alex: SCIM mappings in Okta show groups -> members but we didn't ship a mapping for `rdw_role`. I tried adding custom mapping but Okta requires us to map to an existing schema path. Any workaround?

prashant_eng: For POC the fastest is a small script to patch users after SCIM: `curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.example/v1/admin/users/{id} -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin>" -d '{"role":"inference-dev"}'`. But for prod we need proper group push.

maria_se: Customer also flagged security questionnaire Q12 about token rotation for SCIM bearer tokens. They want TTL and rotation policy.

alex: Good to know. Can we temporarily provide a hosted API key with scoped permissions instead of relying on Dedicated pool role until SCIM is fixed? They prefer not to use broad admin keys.

prashant_eng: We can issue a scoped key limited to `scim:patch` for the POC, 48h expiry. I'll coordinate with security. Meanwhile I'll open a ticket to add `rdw_role` to the SCIM schema so Okta can map groups directly.

jenny_acme: That would unblock us. Also can we get a CSV upload of group->role mapping? Our IdP team can provide a one-off manual mapping if needed.

alex: Sounds good. Action items: @prashant_eng add scoped key + open schema ticket; @maria_se send security note to ACME; @jenny_acme share Okta admin logs. I'll update deal tracker after.

maria_se: On it. :thumbsup:

prashant_eng: Created INF-8173 to add `rdw_role` to SCIM schema. Will follow up with ETA in the ticket. Scoped key created and posted to ACME secure channel.

alex: Thanks all — closing this thread, will reopen if SCIM still fails after schema update. :eyes:
